description: List this workspace's orders, filtered by status/customer/created-date and paginated. Returns summary rows (externalId, status, currency, totalAmount, itemCount, timestamps) plus pagination { page, perPage, total }, newest first. Use get_order to fetch one order's full detail (line items, payments, shipments, returns) by externalId.

customerExternalId.description: Filter to one storefront customer by their externalId (the id from the source system). Omit to list all customers' orders.

from.description: Only orders created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z).

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Default 20.

status.description: Filter by order status. Omit to return every status. Allowed: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded.

to.description: Only orders created at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z).

name: list_orders
title: List orders
